summary: Evaluate AI use cases, shape business cases, and plan portfolio governance. Explore this five-day applied AI strategy course.
lede: Applied AI for business strategy helps leaders compare proposals and identify opportunities that fit business priorities. For strategy, transformation, and functional leaders, the course covers mapping business problems to AI opportunities, scoring value, feasibility, and risk, and assessing data and operating readiness. Learners also build ROI and payback assumptions, assign risk ownership, and shape portfolio roadmaps and decision gates without needing to code.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess, sponsor, govern, or translate AI proposals into business plans and portfolio decisions. It suits intermediate-level learners with familiarity with business priorities, operating measures, or project selection.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with business planning, operational measures, or project and investment decisions is recommended. No coding or model-building experience is required.
